name: Tagesschau API (ARD news)
summary: JSON feed of current German news stories, videos and search results from tagesschau.de, free for private non-commercial use.
description: The api2u endpoints behind the Tagesschau app return the latest news and breaking items, filterable by region and department (ressort), plus a search over articles and videos. Each item has an id, title, date, type (story or video), tags, a link to the web page and often a teaser image and video streams. Content is in German. The API is documented by the community bund.dev project rather than by ARD itself.

rate_limit.summary: The community OpenAPI description says more than 60 requests per hour is not permitted; the server sends cache-control max-age=291.

license.name: Private non-commercial use only; publication not allowed except content under the Tagesschau CC licence

coverage.geographic: Germany and world news, German language
coverage.temporal: Current news; items from the same day at check

agent_notes: Items are polymorphic: check type (story or video) before reading fields; videos carry streams instead of body text. Page backwards with the nextPage URL returned by /news/ (a date-based link) and with resultPage in /search/. regions=1 returned items; other values were not explored. Keep calls well under 60 per hour and cache for about five minutes.
caveats: This is the app backend (api2u) documented by the community; the official api2 path returned 403 and ARD gives no stability guarantee, hence status unstable.
The usage note in the community spec limits use to private non-commercial purposes and forbids publishing the content; read tagesschau.de terms before reuse.
/homepage and /channels returned a 308 redirect to the same path without a trailing slash.

verification.notes: Exact example executed without credentials; /news/ with regions and ressort, and /search/ also returned 200.
